Brain-CT-Seg: AI for Brain Tumor Segmentation & Risk Volumetry

Overcoming Machine, Deep Learning, and Clinical Radiologist Barriers in Non-Contrast CT

Machine / Acquisition

• The rotation problem (head tilt & couch skew)
• Vendor variability (Siemens, GE, Philips)

Software / Deep Learning

• Failure of standard CNNs under rotation
• Severe 12–18% Dice drop under domain shift

Medical Doctor / Radiologist

• Subjectivity of manual tumor delineation
• High inter-observer variance (Dice 65–75%)

Mod-Seg-SE(2) Consensus Platform
Equivariant Group Theory Backbone (C8 / N=8 Rotations) + 6-Model Consensus Engine
Equivariant R2Conv (C8) Guarantees f(g·x) = g·f(x). Boundary is identical at any head tilt or couch angle.
6-Model Consensus Engine Combines Mod-Seg-SE(2), HarmonicNet, nnU-Net with calibrated 0.80 agreement threshold.
Automated 3D Volumetry Quantifies Tumor Volume (mL), Edema Core, Sphericity, and Hemispheric Midline Shift.
84.2% Dice | 73.1% IoU SOTA Segmentation & Quantitative 3D Volumetry
